title: summary
description: The TL;DR: one line that matters, up to five points with a state dot, and the one thing to do first; or a news story with why it matters; or a team standup.

kind.description: brief: tldr, points, do first. story: a news story (`story`). standup: `people`.

tldr.description: kind brief: the one line that matters. With no points it is drawn as the empty state (“Nothing new since yesterday.”).

text.description: The point, one or two lines: “Dentist at 11 AM, leave at 10:40”.

emphasis.description: The first words of `text` set in semibold: “Dentist at 11 AM”. Must be a prefix of `text`.

state.description: The dot: neutral is ink, quiet is grey (background facts like the weather), unverified a dashed ring; the others their state colour.

items.description: One point. A claim in the evidence reads “Said by …”.

points.description: kind brief: what’s behind the TL;DR, most important first. Empty only for the empty state.

text.description: The one thing to do first, and why it’s easy: “Renew the passport. The form is filled in; it takes 5 minutes.”

do_first.description: One thing, never a list. Its action is drawn as the card’s primary button.

status.description: confirmed: the primary source (the company, the court, the official record) says so, or two independent outlets with their own reporting. Anything else is a rumor, however credible the outlet: say who reports it in `body`.

topic.description: A neutral tag: Policy, Apple, Markets.

headline.description: The story in one line. A rumour is worded as one: “Apple may…, a report says”.

body.description: Two lines: what happened, who says so.

why.description: Why it matters for this reader, specifically: their apps, money, plans. Not a general take.

primary.description: The original: the company’s post, the ruling, the official journal.

sources.description: Where it’s reported. Counted in the meta line (“3 sources · 2 h ago”); Show the Sources lists them.

blocked.description: What blocks them: “Waiting on Stripe’s report”. Shown with the Blocked tag.

note.description: When there is no update: “No update yet”, “Off today”. Shown in grey.

items.description: One member’s update, in their own words. With no done, today, blocked or note it reads “No update yet”.

people.description: kind standup: one row per person or Bot, in the team’s order; blocked members first when it matters.
